MAR 15th, 1929.

REPORT ON Moving Picture Exhibition at the Foreign
Y. M. C. A. Bubbling Well Road.

Made by S.D.I. Prince Forwarded by W.Gwens A.C.Pol.

Reference to the attached C.D.C. 96 Wong Kung Foh
(黄淦福) was detailed to attend this entertainment and
makes the following report:
At 9 p.m. March 14th, 1929, in the Main Hall,
2nd floor, Foreign Y.M.C.A., No. 33 Bubbling Well Road.
There were about 200 persons present, Chinese and Foreign,
amongst whom were Messrs Fitch, Chairman of the Foreign Y.M.C.A.,
Koong Ziang Yung (孔祥榕), Vice-Chairman of the Red Swas-
tika Society & Hsisan C. Liu, Member of the Technical Committee,
Yangtse River Commission, also Ministry of Communications,
National Government. Mr. Fitch, Chairman of the Y.M.C.A.
made a short speech regarding the valuable pictures taken by
the International Newsreel, and the outline of the siege of
Chochow in 1927, and introduced Mr. Koong Ziang Yung, Vice-
Chairman of the Red Swastika Society, and Mr. Hsisan C. Liu
(刘锡三), Ministry of Communications, National Government
to the audience. Mr. Koong Ziang Yung made the following
speeches in Chinese, Mr. Hsisan C. Liu (刘锡三) acting
as his Interpreter.
In 1927, when fighting took place at Chochow
between troops of the Shansi and Fengtien Armies, thousands
of residents in the locality suffered great hardships; many
being starved to death, their homes being destroyed by gun fire.
Two famous pagodas, the last of the local monuments were
seriously damaged. The idea of shewing these pictures
tonight is to give you our idea of the difficulties and dangers

1929年3月15日。

关于静安寺路外国青年会电影放映会的报告。

由特别侦探（S.D.I.）普林斯（Prince）制作，经副总巡捕（A.C.Pol.）Gwens转发。

参照附件 C.D.C. 96，黄淦福（Wong Kung Foh）奉派出席此次娱乐活动，并提交如下报告：
1929年3月14日晚9时，在静安寺路33号外国青年会二楼大厅。
现场约有200人，包括华人和外国人，其中有外国青年会主席费奇先生（Mr. Fitch）、红卍字会副主席孔祥榕先生（Koong Ziang Yung）、国民政府交通部兼长江技术委员会技术委员刘锡三先生（Hsisan C. Liu）。青年会主席费奇先生就国际新闻影片公司拍摄的珍贵照片作了简短演讲，介绍了1927年涿州（Chochow）之围的概况，并向观众介绍了红卍字会副主席孔祥榕先生和国民政府交通部刘锡三先生（刘锡三）。孔祥榕先生用中文发表了以下演讲，刘锡三先生（刘锡三）担任其翻译。
1927年，当晋军和奉军在涿州发生战斗时，当地成千上万的居民遭受了巨大的苦难；许多人饿死，他们的家园被炮火摧毁。两座著名的塔，即当地仅存的古迹，也遭到严重破坏。今晚放映这些影片的目的是为了让各位了解我们在当时涿州之围期间，组织救援队并设法通过封锁线去帮助和救济受难同胞，以及将他们从城市转移到安全区时所面临的困难和危险

we had to contend with in getting up relief parties and getting
them through to help and relieve the distressed natives during
the siege of Chochow at that time, and to get them away from
the City to a safety zone. Mr. Koong thanked the audience
for their attendance after which the picture exhibition was
proceeded with, scenes were shewn as follows:- The advance
attack of the Shansi Army, some thousands of troops, guns and
transport wagons crossing a creek. Artillery battle between
the troops of the two armies. Barbed wire entanglements etc.
Mr. Koong is shewn being escorted from Chochow City by soldiers
Refugees leaving the beleaguered City, and securing money and
provisions from the staff of the Red Swastika Society: War
trophies, artillery etc captured by the Fengtien Army, from
the Shansi troops, also a picture of General Fu Tso Nyi
(傅作義), Commander-in-Chief of the Shansi Army, and his
body-guard leaving Chochow for Paoting by train, after the
defeat of his Army by Fengtien troops. The exhibition was
concluded at 10.15 p.m.

A.C.P. Pol'.

C.D.I.

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, WEDNESDAY, MARCH 13, 1929.

...moving pictures by
"New" Wong of the siege of
Chochow in 1927, taken under fire
and showing actual battles and
scenes of pitiful starvation and
desolation will be shown at the
Foreign Y.M.C.A., at 9 p.m. to-
morrow. A short description in
Chinese (with translation) will be
given by Mr. W.S.Y. Kung, lineal
descendant of Confucius, 75th
generation, Vice-Chairman of the
Red Swastika Society which
brought relief to the inhabitants of
the beleaguered city. Admission
will be free to members, their
friends, and the public.

a. c. (Pal)

pages.zh:
《字林西报》，1929年3月13日，星期三。

……由“新”王先生拍摄的1927年涿州之围的电影，是在炮火下拍摄的，展示了真实的战斗以及令人怜悯的饥饿和荒凉场景，将于明晚9点在外国青年会放映。孔子第七十五代直系后裔、红卍字会副主席龚维新先生（Mr. W.S.Y. Kung）将用中文作简要介绍（附翻译），该会曾向被围困城市的居民提供救济。会员、其朋友及公众可免费入场。

a. c. (Pal)
